subtitle: Lesson 2 · Azure Monitor & Log Analytics in Depth

code:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where ActivityStatusValue == "Failure"
| summarize FailureCount = count() by Caller, OperationNameValue
| order by FailureCount desc
caption: Table first, then a left-to-right pipeline — no SELECT, no FROM.

eyebrow: Turning raw rows into a time series
code:
Perf
| where ObjectName == "Processor" and CounterName == "% Processor Time"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
| summarize AvgCPU = avg(CounterValue) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer
| render timechart
caption: bin() buckets time; summarize aggregates; render draws the chart in place.

eyebrow: A real join across two tables
code:
Perf
| where CounterName == "% Processor Time" and TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| summarize AvgCPU = avg(CounterValue) by Computer
| where AvgCPU > 80
| join kind=inner (
    Heartbeat
    | summarize LastHeartbeat = max(TimeGenerated) by Computer
) on Computer
| where LastHeartbeat > ago(10m)
caption: High CPU AND still healthy — a question neither table answers alone.
